description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for creating and managing test plugins and registries related to channel plugins in a messaging system. It includes functions to generate test plugin configurations, a test registry, and specific plugin base configurations for Microsoft Teams and outbound channels.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a plugin registry object with optional channel registrations.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Generates a base configuration for a channel plugin with specified parameters.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base configuration for a Microsoft Teams channel plugin.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a Microsoft Teams test plugin with optional aliases and outbound adapter.

methods.name: createOutboundTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a test plugin for outbound channels with optional messaging adapter.

methods.name: createBindingResolverTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a binding resolver test plugin with optional resolveBindingAccountId setup.
